title: 第15章 猛虎落泪第16章 霁雪
lines: 缝隙前的碎石被乐临清挥剑拍开，她的脸上还残留着一丝红霞，右手握着长剑不自然的发紧。
许平秋紧随其后走出，双手十分自然地搭在了她的肩上。
此时山洞内依旧盘踞了不少受伤的妖兽，在这里盘踞，默默舔舐着伤口，向两人投来警觉戒备的目光。
洞穴顶部的钟乳石表面依旧湿润，不断向下方的水池中滴落着水滴。
许平秋好奇的指着它问道：“这个钟乳石是不是好东西？”
洞穴，妖兽盘踞，滴水，还是钟乳石！
如此隐秘的洞穴，又有这么多妖兽盘踞，还滴着水，更是钟乳石！许平秋感觉，这要不是什么天材地宝，简直有些说不过去。
乐临清顺着他的手指望去，观察了一会后说道：“这应该是百年石钟乳，但可惜生长在这种绝灵之地，只蕴含一些可有可无的药性，也就起些治皮肉伤的效用。”
“这样啊，好吧。”
许平秋悻悻的将目光收回，伸手轻轻捏了捏乐临清的肩膀，他还以为自己这次走了大运，随便钻个山洞，就能收获什么绝世珍宝呢。
谈话间，一道猫猫祟祟的身影忽然从一旁悄悄的蠕动而出。
但它的体型太大，这样做反倒是有种侮辱许平秋和乐临清视力的感觉。
它不会觉得它这样很可爱吧？
许平秋盯着白虎，白虎盯着他，眨巴着眼睛，似乎有些疑惑为什么许平秋这么容易发现自己，神色有一些懵。
好吧，这样确实很可爱。
许平秋询问道：“能把它也带回去吗，我觉得它是一个可塑之才。”
他想起了之前人虎合一的峥嵘岁月，而且这山洞还是它带着自己和乐临清来的，没有趁人之危，可以说是强行把自己的路给走宽了。
“嗯，它的灵智似乎要比其他妖兽要高一些，你想养的话不成问题。”乐临清看了一眼白虎，她也猜到了为什么自己会出现在山洞里，便答应了。
“啧，很好，恭喜你成功成为一头有编制的虎。”许平秋上前开始狂薅虎头。
反正有乐临清在，倒也不用担心葬身虎口。
“嗷嗷嗷~”
白虎当即发出了矜持拒绝的声音，表示它不是一头随便的虎，但在许平秋又从怀里摸出一颗玉元丹塞进它嘴里后，它便立刻沉稳了下来，喉咙里发出满足的呼噜声，表示今天别把它当虎。
玉元丹的效力发挥的很快，白虎原本还有些瘸的腿很快就恢复。
在离开山洞后，两人再度骑上了它，向着之前的战场赶去。
但似乎血腥味吸引了附近的妖兽，此刻地上只剩下了些零星的血迹。
算算时间，妖兽消化快的话，陈大朋和蓝雨伯应该已经变成了新鲜的肥料。
见状，许平秋也没有停留，而是给白虎指了个来时的方向，向着神陨之地外走去。
望着这个方向，乐临清心中其实是有一点小疑惑的，她总感觉错了。
但是想到上次迷路，就是因为自己的这个直觉，她还是选择了相信许平秋。
穿过密林，白虎跑得呼哧呼哧、大舌头直吐，而越接近外面，许平秋越感觉到眉心间有些怪异。
一种奇怪的视野展现在他的脑海中，岩壁与树影绞成旋涡，不断的掉帧撕裂，甚至时不时泛起雪花，尤其是白虎奔跑还在上下晃来晃去，这种眩晕感比之前乐临清带他螺旋上天还要刺激。
content_en:
The gravel in front of the gap was slapped away by Le Linqing with his sword. There was still a hint of red on her face, and the sword in her right hand was unnaturally tight.
Xu Pingqiu walked out closely behind, placing his hands on her shoulders very naturally.
At this time, there were still many injured monsters entrenched in the cave. They were entrenched here, silently licking their wounds, and casting wary glances at the two of them.
The surface of the stalactites at the top of the cave is still wet, dripping water into the pool below.
Xu Pingqiu pointed at it curiously and asked: "Is this stalactite a good thing?"
The cave is occupied by monsters, dripping water, and stalactites!
Such a secret cave is home to so many monsters, dripping water, and even stalactites! Xu Pingqiu felt that if this wasn't a natural treasure, it would be unjustifiable.
Le Linqing followed his hand and said after observing for a while: "This should be a century-old stalactite, but unfortunately it grows in such a unique place. It only contains some dispensable medicinal properties and can only be used to treat skin wounds."
"That's it, okay."
Xu Pingqiu looked back angrily, reaching out and gently pinching Le Linqing's shoulder. He thought he was lucky this time and would be able to harvest some unique treasure by just digging into a cave.
During the conversation, a sneaky figure of a cat suddenly squirmed quietly from the side.
But it was too big, and doing so felt like an insult to Xu Pingqiu and Le Linqing's eyesight.
Doesn't it think it's cute like this?
Xu Pingqiu stared at Bai Hu, who stared at him, blinking, as if he was confused as to why Xu Pingqiu found him so easily, and looked a little confused.
Okay, that's really cute.
Xu Pingqiu asked: "Can you take it back? I think it is a malleable talent."
He recalled the glorious years when humans and tigers became one, and it was the one who brought him and Le Linqing to this cave, instead of taking advantage of others' danger. It could be said that he had forced his way to a wider path.
"Well, its intelligence seems to be higher than other monsters. If you want to raise it, it won't be a problem." Le Linqing glanced at the white tiger. She also guessed why she appeared in the cave, and agreed.
"Tsk, very good. Congratulations on your success in becoming a well-organized tiger." Xu Pingqiu stepped forward and began to pluck the tiger's head wildly.
Anyway, with Le Linqing here, there is no need to worry about being killed.
"Ouch~~"
The white tiger immediately made a reserved sound of rejection, indicating that it was not a casual tiger. However, after Xu Pingqiu took out another Jade Yuan Dan from his arms and stuffed it into its mouth, it immediately calmed down and let out a contented purr in its throat, indicating that it should not be regarded as a tiger today.
The effectiveness of the Jade Yuan Pill came into play very quickly, and Bai Hu's originally lame leg recovered quickly.
After leaving the cave, the two rode it again and rushed towards the previous battlefield.
But it seemed that the smell of blood attracted nearby monsters, and there were only some sporadic blood stains left on the ground.
Calculating the time, if the monster digested quickly, Chen Dapeng and Lan Yubo should have turned into fresh fertilizer.
Seeing this, Xu Pingqiu did not stop, but pointed Bai Hu in the direction he came from, and walked towards the outside of the Land of God's Fall.
Looking in this direction, Le Linqing actually had a little doubt in her heart. She always felt that she was wrong.
But thinking about the last time she got lost, it was because of her intuition that she still chose to trust Xu Pingqiu.
Walking through the dense forest, the white tiger ran huffing and puffing out its tongue. The closer it got to the outside, the more Xu Pingqiu felt something strange between his eyebrows.
A strange vision appeared in his mind. The rock walls and tree shadows were twisted into a vortex, frames were constantly dropped and torn, and even snowflakes appeared from time to time. Especially when the white tiger was running and dangling up and down, this dizziness was even more exciting than when Le Linqing took him spiraling up to the sky.
